description: Removes an event from the calendar of address `id`. Pass a series’ id to remove all of it, or the `id` `get_agenda` gives one date of it, with `mode: "single"` (that date) or `"future"` (that date onwards). Attendees are not told. To turn down an invitation somebody else sent, use `respond_to_invitation` instead.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this send. Reuse the same key when retrying the same send, and it goes out once. Without one, an identical call within the hour counts as a retry.

name: delete_calendar_event
title: Take an event off the calendar
